title_zh: 为奇幻角色选择送信任务

scenario.label_zh: 为奇幻游戏任务选择非战斗的角色目标
scenario.goal_zh: 明确反抗者角色的当前目标并选择以送信而非战斗推进任务

context_zh: 朋友 Tomas 与 June 设计自创奇幻桌游角色，全部人物、政体和地域均为虚构。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: My character is a rebel, but I don't want every scene to turn into a fight.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: Then give the rebellion a practical problem. What does your character need to do?

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: Carry a message across the realm before the council meeting.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: That makes a clear quest. The obstacles can be finding a guide and deciding whom to trust.

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: Good. I'll make the character a reluctant messenger, not someone looking for a battle.

targets.sense_zh: 为实现目标而进行的探寻或冒险任务
